Name: Lumisteria Clothes
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
Halloween is closer and closer, be ready for it with some variety of magic hats !
[center]
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img][/center]

This mod adds 12 hats, 5 dresses and 19 shirts : 10 shirts assorted to the flower dance hats, and 9 inspired by flower dance outfits so your character will match the other dancers. (Sorry, they will still dance akwardly !). Now you also have some cute dresses to wear, and magic hats for Halloween.
[center]

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img][/center]How to obtain the shirts ?
Soon, you'll be able to buy them at the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4798]Tailor Mouse's shop [/url](in a future update).
You can also spawn them with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url].

How to obtain the hats ?
Come to old old old haus, poke. Bring coines.

Credits : [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855]Seasonal Hats[/url] was an inspiration for this mod. Look at it, it has some beautiful stuff !
